segments.MAL.1.1-3: The LORD says he loved Jacob but hated Esau
segments.MAL.1.4-5: The LORD will destroy what Edom rebuilds
segments.MAL.1.6-7: The LORD says the priests despise his name
segments.MAL.1.8-9: The LORD rejects the priests’ blind and sick animals
segments.MAL.1.10-12: The LORD will accept no offering from the priests
segments.MAL.1.13-14: The LORD condemns the priests for offering bad animals
segments.MAL.2.1-2: The LORD warns the priests of a curse
segments.MAL.2.5-7: Levi honored God and taught the truth
segments.MAL.2.8-9: The priests turned from God’s way and taught wrongly
segments.MAL.2.10-12: Judah’s men marry women who serve foreign gods
segments.MAL.2.13-13: The LORD no longer accepts the people’s offerings
segments.MAL.2.14-16: The LORD hates divorce and wants husbands to be faithful
segments.MAL.2.17-17: The people tire the LORD by saying evil is good
segments.MAL.3.1-3: The LORD will send a messenger and come to his temple
segments.MAL.3.4-5: The LORD will judge sorcerers, adulterers and oppressors
segments.MAL.3.6-7: The LORD does not change and calls Israel to return
segments.MAL.3.8-9: The people rob God by not giving tithes and offerings
segments.MAL.3.10-12: The LORD promises blessing for the full tithe
segments.MAL.3.13-15: The people say that serving God is useless
segments.MAL.3.16-16: A scroll is written for those who fear the LORD
segments.MAL.3.17-18: The LORD will spare those who serve him
segments.MAL.4.4-6: Israel must remember the law and Elijah will come
